subject: types, *: move truncate flags to the types context (#47522)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent with focus on executor/expression/planner/sessionctx/store/table/tablecodec. The change moves truncate handling (IgnoreTruncate/TruncateAsWarning) into `types/context` via `TypeCtx.Flags()` + `TypeCtx.HandleTruncate`, updates StmtCtx reset/init and PB-flag+timezone initialization (`InitFromPBFlagAndTz`), and adjusts key runtime call sites (casts/ToBool, pushdown flags, mock copr handlers). The CheckTableExec/`ColumnInfos2ColumnsAndNames` concurrency guard was updated to avoid concurrent flag toggling. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in scoped behavior.
